description: Read-only. Look up municipality ids — the `municipalityId` filter of `fastighetsbenchmark_search_property_units`. Shared reference data, the same for every key. Each row has `id`, `name`, `countryCode` and `code` (the official municipality code; for Sweden the SCB kommunkod, e.g. '0180'). Example: nameContains 'Stockholm' → id 21. Read-only — never writes.

code.description: Exact official municipality code (Sweden: SCB kommunkod), e.g. '0180'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: fastighetsbenchmark_list_municipalities

code.description: Official municipality code (Sweden: SCB kommunkod), e.g. '0180'; absent outside Sweden.

id.description: Municipality id; use as municipalityId in search_property_units, e.g. 21.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: List municipalities (shared)
